title: Towards A Tri-View Diffusion Framework for Recommendation

problem.claim: Recommendation models need to represent and generate comprehensive user preferences.

gap.claim: Prior work does not rigorously examine diffusion models in recommendation tasks.

contributions.claim: A thermodynamic analysis compares the completeness of recommender models and distinguishes energy maximization in diffusion-based models from entropy reduction in classic models.
A minimalistic diffusion framework combines energy maximization and entropy reduction through Helmholtz free-energy maximization.
The framework combines an anisotropy-preserving denoiser with AR-GSP, which uses acceptance-rejection sampling and timestep-dependent Gumbel Softmax for hard-negative and adaptive sampling.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Theoretical analyses and extensive experiments reportedly show superiority over baselines in accuracy and efficiency.

narrative_sequence.summary: Diffusion models have attracted interest in recommendation because they can distill, model, and generate comprehensive user preferences.
Existing work lacks a rigorous examination of diffusion models for recommendation.
A thermodynamic investigation reports different operating principles for diffusion-based and classic recommender models.
The proposed framework combines Helmholtz free-energy maximization, anisotropy preservation, and AR-GSP sampling.
The authors report theoretical and experimental superiority in accuracy and efficiency.

source_observation.claim: The abstract contrasts energy maximization in diffusion-based recommenders with entropy reduction in classic recommenders.

interpretation.claim: Modeling choices may be understood through complementary objectives rather than a single optimization principle.

application.claim: When designing generative recommendation models, examine whether complementary objectives can be unified in one optimization criterion.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether this thermodynamic framing transfers beyond the reported recommendation setting.
